hints.title: Bidirectional Ring Rotation
hints.text: Spelling each character in the key requires choosing between rotating the dial ring clockwise or counter-clockwise.

hints.title: Minimal Distance on Circular Dial
hints.text: Between dial position p and target position q, distance is min(abs(p - q), len(ring) - abs(p - q)).

hints.title: Dynamic Programming on Ring Positions
hints.text: Map each character in ring to all its index locations. Use memoization or dynamic programming dp(r_idx, k_idx) representing minimum rotations to finish key[k_idx:] starting at dial index r_idx. Try each matching position of key[k_idx].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Dynamic programming state (ring_pos, key_idx) with circular distance minimization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice of nearest matching character fails on subsequent characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization table of size K * R prevents redundant rotation subproblem checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model as dynamic programming over candidate character positions.
